subject: Request to Verify Draft BL Against Shipping Instruction – Shipment MP-2109
body:
Dear Operations Team,

Please review the attached draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction for shipment MP-2109. Kindly verify the shipper, consignee, notify party, port of loading, port of discharge, container count, and gross weight.

Please let me know if there are any discrepancies before the draft BL is finalized.

Thank you.

Regards,
Olivia Tan
Logistics Coordinator
Meridian Palm Trading Sdn. Bhd.

T: +60 3 3168 2288
E: olivia.tan@meridianpalm.com
W: www.meridianpalm.com
note: Scan variant: the attachments are image-only PDFs of the SI and BL crops, so extraction takes the VLM fallback path.
